backfire-effect-coach.note: The inherited article contained fabricated trials, physiological explanations, effect ranges and self-reported cohort outcomes. The effective public record is rewritten as a bounded disagreement-and-claim-check protocol without an evidence claim.

belief-update-coach.note: The inherited article contained numeric confidence prescriptions, sample-size rules, fabricated observations and arbitrary update ranges. The effective public record is rewritten as a bounded belief-review record without an evidence claim.

biomimicry-creative-problem-solving.note: The inherited article contained fabricated performance outcomes, internal hit rates and unsupported biological explanations. The effective public record is rewritten as a function-to-principle design exercise without an evidence claim.

bold-brainstorm-kickoff.note: The inherited article contained fabricated session outcomes, multipliers, percentage claims and pseudo-precise timing rules. The effective public record is rewritten as a provocation-to-feasible-idea exercise without an evidence claim.

backfire-effect-coach.reason: The effective protocol clarifies a contested claim, states uncertainty and chooses a check or stopping point. Critical Thinking and Conflict Repair are the concrete Topics.

belief-update-coach.reason: The effective protocol makes the basis, uncertainty, revision and future change condition of a belief explicit. Critical Thinking and Metacognition are the concrete Topics.

biomimicry-creative-problem-solving.reason: The effective protocol translates a function into a transferable design principle and generates applications. Creative Problem Solving and Idea Generation are the concrete Topics.

bold-brainstorm-kickoff.reason: The effective protocol uses an extreme seed to produce variants, then restores constraints and selects one feasible test. Creative Problem Solving and Idea Generation are the concrete Topics.
